notes: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after eleven searches (the eight legislative candidates, then Curt Soehl, Tim Williams and Michael Lambertus). Everything after that was read by opening pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py): county and city government sites reached from the South Dakota Association of County Officials' county list (https://www.sdcounties.org/counties/). No search engine was read in place of the search tool.

Campaign websites for the eight legislative candidates were learned from South Dakota Public Broadcasting's 'Meet the Candidates' pages; each site was then opened and kept only because its own pages name the candidate and the office.

Karen Springer's own_words is her site's disclaimer line, which names the county party as paying for the site; it is not recorded as an endorsement because it is not on the party's own page. Delete it if a disclaimer is not to count as a party statement.
Brittany Folk (Grant County Auditor): the county's Auditor page names a different person with the same family name as the office holder; nothing is recorded for the candidate.

Curt Soehl: a search result said he sat on the Sioux Falls City Council (Central District, term ending 2026), but the city's page for him now answers 404 and the Council Members page no longer lists him, so no office is recorded. The news pages found were about the 2024 race.

Not found on their county's pages, or the county's site could not be reached (no address found, an expired certificate, or a page built by script): Mary Goss (Bennett), Michael Lambertus (Brookings), Shawn Hinsz (Corson), Joseph Bury (Day), Jason Latham (Harding), Kevin Baloun (Hyde), Rich Sylva (Jones), Tim Williams (Pennington), Susan B Lamb (Sully). Minnehaha County's site answered the script with a short stub and was left alone. keloland.com answered 403 and was left alone.

No birth year, no party's own published endorsement and no earlier run under a party label was found for anyone in this part. Sitting legislators (Fitzgerald, Roby, Mehlhaff, Vilhauer) already have record pages, so only their websites are recorded.
